**(i) `b459793c40` / `Pic0ChartLocusH0One.lean` — NOT a red build. No rooted sorry anywhere in AJCR except the protected file.**

It also has **zero bare `sorry` tokens** now: the only `sorry` string left is prose at line 11 ("proofs deliberately `sorry` so that the shapes are..."), which is stale relative to the file's own content. So the commit subject is the alarming part, not the state — someone appears to have closed the scaffold without updating the header sentence that announces it.

That was my highest-value next action at the time. Commit `262d7af1d5` and `658cf72b0f` have since landed it, so the exposure is closed. Not worth acting on now.
- **p2 vs p4 in the coverage / `chartLocus` cluster — LIVE overlap, and it has partly materialised.** Neither held a row when I measured; both were deep in the same files (`Pic0ChartVMonotone.lean`, `Pic0ChartRestrictedFibreSat.lean`, `Pic0ChartRestrictedFibre.lean`, `Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling.lean`, `Pic0ChartCoveragePointwise.lean`). p4 then claimed a new row `AJCR.w4-rep.datum.bot-refute` (I-1194) and has landed `891cb0589c` / `3851a6ada7` in `Pic0ChartVMonotone.lean` — **p1's file**, whose `isLocallySurjective_of_bot` p4's I-1204 now reports as vacuous. p2's stated lead was Riemann–Roch at the chart locus forcing `h⁰ = 1`, which is plausibly what `Pic0ChartLocusH0One.lean` is; if that file is p2's and p4 is rewriting the `⊥` endpoint reasoning it depends on, that is the collision to watch. **I did not verify which lane authored `Pic0ChartLocusH0One.lean`** — that check was still open when your message arrived.

## Part (B) — complete, all three antecedents

Antecedents of `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` (`AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SigmaSheaf.lean:161`). Statements read, not docstrings. Both headline theorems re-verified axiom-clean `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` against a `sorryAx`-firing control.

**1. `IsChartUniv`** (`Picard/Pic0ChartPair.lean:173` — a `def ... : Prop`). Most advanced producer: **`isChartUniv_bot`**, `Picard/Pic0ChartRestrictedFibreSat.lean:223`, axiom-clean. It is a genuine producer **only at `V = ⊥`**, where that file's own line 53 says it "carries no content". All four other declarations concluding `IsChartUniv` are conditional on hypotheses with no producer: `isChartUniv_of_isChartLocusFibre` (`Pic0ChartUnivReduce.lean:184`), `isChartUniv_of_restrictedChartFibre` (`Pic0ChartRestrictedFibre.lean:158`), `isChartUniv_of_unrestricted` (`Pic0ChartPair.lean:191`, hypothesis false at `⊤`), `isChartUniv_antitone` (`Pic0ChartVMonotone.lean:148`, transports an existing one). **Producer at the degenerate end only; consumers elsewhere.**

**2. Zariski-local surjectivity of `Sigma.desc f`.** Most advanced: **`isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc`**, `Picard/Pic0ChartLocalSurjectivity.lean:106` — real instance producer, but from `ChartsCoverLocally` (line 86), a `def ... : Prop` whose own line 42 says "the hypothesis, not a theorem". The one unconditional producer is `chartsCoverLocally_of_forall_surjective` (line 125, axiom-clean), and its docstring concedes it is "the degenerate case (and not the geometric situation: no single Abel chart is surjective on all tests)". **No producer for the geometric case.** Note p4's I-1204 now reports `isLocallySurjective_of_bot` vacuous, which tightens this rather than loosening it.

**3. `rep i : (divFunctor C π (nn i)).RepresentableBy (D i)`.** Most advanced: **`divFunctor_representableBy_of_id`**, `Picard/DivRepAffPullClause.lean:504`, axiom-clean, rooted (name confirmed via `#check` — it is in bare `AlgebraicGeometry`, not `.Curve.Clause` as the file's namespace nesting suggests). Its hypothesis needs `IsDivRepClassify` (`Picard/DivRepClassifyZar.lean:90`), which is a `def ... : Prop` with **zero declarations concluding it anywhere in the tree** — grep census returns exactly one declaration-position hit, the definition. Sibling `divFunctor_representableBy_of_chartRange` (`DivRepChartRange.lean:224`, axiom-clean) says outright "Nothing here produces such a class". **Consumers only. This is U2, fully assembled above an obligation with no inhabitant.**

Not checked: which lane authored `Pic0ChartLocusH0One.lean`; whether p2's final claim collides with p4's `bot-refute`; the blueprint JSON's `lean_ok` flags (I measured `hgraph/nodes/` only, and `.archon-horizon/blueprints/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge.json` is modified-uncommitted); individual elaborability of the 17 unrooted modules beyond `Pic0ThetaCocycle`.
